name: DNAture website species artwork
status: Website species artwork: generated standing-cat and golden-retriever engravings, plus source-derived compact silhouettes. Source brandbook and original exports remain unchanged.

engraving.method: Extracted native vector animal paths with Poppler, isolated each animal, recolored black/white to ink/mint, removed a detached dog-artwork speck, normalized to a shared canvas and baseline, and optimized path coordinates. No raster tracing or embedded bitmap.

silhouette.method: Adapted the existing source SVG exports, removed the circular badge and outer ring, recolored the animal to ink, and normalized its optical size. Original exports are preserved.

standing_cat.method: Standing pose created with built-in image_gen using the original cat and dog as references. Converted with vtracer 0.6.15 into native paths using exact ink/mint fills, then normalized to the shared canvas, optical width, and dog baseline. No embedded bitmap.

golden_retriever.method: Golden retriever created with built-in image_gen using the original dog and current standing cat as style/pose references. Converted with vtracer 0.6.15 to native paths in exact ink/mint fills and normalized to the shared canvas, optical width, and baseline. No embedded bitmap.

golden_retriever_lighter.method: Lightened the dense fur shadows using built-in image_gen while retaining the golden retriever pose and composition; traced into native ink/mint SVG paths with vtracer 0.6.15 at ink threshold 0.6 to retain the lighter strokes, preserving shared canvas, optical width, and baseline. No embedded bitmap.

border_collie.method: Built-in image_gen generation and style refinement, converted into native SVG paths with vtracer 0.6.15 using scripts/trace-walking-artwork.py. Normalized to the existing pet artwork canvas and baseline.

usage_rules: Use the engraving at 96px or larger; prefer the silhouette at 24–80px.
The compact set uses distinct source-approved silhouettes, not crops of the engraving poses.
Place on light or turquoise surfaces; the ink silhouette is not a reverse asset for dark surfaces.
Preserve proportions, transparent margins, and natural contours. Do not add a card, circular crop, border, shadow, or category color.
Species artwork identifies an animal, not a product category or breed recommendation.
Pair product eligibility with explicit text such as Solo para gatos; do not infer compatibility from artwork alone.
For products suitable for both species, show both with text. Never imply cat-only or dog-only suitability without product data.
Use alt empty when adjacent text already names the species; otherwise provide contextual alt text.
Use lucide-react for functional interface actions; this artwork serves species identity.
